https://www.reuters.com/markets/us/us-in.standfirst: August PCE was softer than feared without evidence consumers stopped spending.
body: PCE rose 0.3% monthly and 3.4% yearly; core PCE rose 0.2% and 3.0%.
https://www.reuters.com/markets/us/us-in.why_it_matters: Price pressure was softer than feared, but consumers have not meaningfully pulled back, complicating the Federal Reserve rate outlook.
https://www.reuters.com/markets/us/us-in.uncertainty: One month does not establish a new trend.

https://www.reuters.com/world/china/chin.uncertainty: PMI measures direction and breadth, not output volume.

https://www.nature.com/articles/s41562-0.standfirst: A multidisciplinary reconstruction places the pre-1788 population above many historical estimates.
body: Modeled excess deaths through 1861: about 2.06 million.

https://aeon.co/essays/play-is-doing-its.standfirst: The essay argues that play is distinctive when it can abandon the official objective.
body: It contrasts competitive agon with spontaneous paidia.
Its target is optimization spreading into leisure.
https://aeon.co/essays/play-is-doing-its.why_it_matters: Streaks, rankings and metrics increasingly reach into leisure; the essay makes a case for activities whose value partly depends on not producing a measurable result.
https://aeon.co/essays/play-is-doing-its.uncertainty: Rules and competition can also produce creativity.
argument_map: Question: what is lost when play is continuously measured?
Thesis: free play depends partly on not having an externally scored objective.
Limit: structured games can also support experimentation.

https://aeon.co/essays/black-holes-ring-.standfirst: Black-hole ringdown connects an observable signal to the unresolved information paradox.
body: A merged black hole settles through damped gravitational-wave modes.
Those modes encode properties such as mass and spin.
https://aeon.co/essays/black-holes-ring-.why_it_matters: It connects modern gravitational-wave measurement to a foundational conflict among relativity, quantum theory and information.
